title: SANE: Quality improvements and correction
description:
- Standard dissector boilerplate (Header/Footer)
- Standard headers
- Standard Epan Tree Type (ett) names
- Consistent variable and definition ordering
- Consistent indentation
- Use of anonymous enums in typedefs
- gboolean -> bool (C11)
- Consistent function name at start of line
- Option type bool interpretation
- Present option title if name is empty
- Rename dissect_sane_internal to dissect_sane_pdu
- Only add sane_pdu to array once
- Retrieve server ports whenever the preference is changed
- Various corrections

notes.body: no longer need Editor Modelines if remenber...
Well, that issue #17253 is still open...
I would prefer to not have the spaces in these strings, but instead in the specifiers at lines 598 and 603

I would too, but unfortunately this results in a superfluous space before the closing bracket when there's no unit (units == 0). For this reason I moved the space into all but the empty entry of the value_string. Otherwise we would end up with code like this

`if (units) {`\
 `proto_item_append_text(item, " (%d %s)", value,`\
 `value_to_str_const(units, sane_option_unit_suffixes, "(unknown unit)"));`\
`} else {`\
 `proto_item_append_text(item, " (%d)", value);`\
`}`

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14125/diffs?diff_id=907163862&start_sha=93c1d298160bce0cfb6a057c912fb2daf62ecf2c#d6f51861f725ce1fe8f5469013f17b3d9e9f68f8_256_255)
Parenthesis around 2nd ternary expression?  Have never seen this before, it took me a few seconds to parse it..

Parenthesis are not required here, the expression would be the same `value == 1 ? "True" : value == 0 ? "False" : "Invalid"` Otherwise we would end up with code like this `const char *value_str = "Invalid";`
`if (value == 1) {`
`value_str = "True";`
`} else if (value == 0) {`
`value_str = "False"`
`}`
`proto_item_append_text(item, " %s", value_str);`

I can accept the nested ternary expressions, am just asking that you do e.g.

```
(value == 1) ?
    "True" :
    (value == 0) ?
        "False" :
        "Invalid");
```

or at least

```
(value == 1) ? "True" : (value == 0 ? "False" : "Invalid")
```

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14125/diffs?diff_id=907163862&start_sha=93c1d298160bce0cfb6a057c912fb2daf62ecf2c#d6f51861f725ce1fe8f5469013f17b3d9e9f68f8_608_615)
